answer: Charge each identity in elapsed time, not in compute. A key must publish a verifiable delay proof before acting: a long chain of sequential hash rounds, cheap to verify, impossible to fake. Machines cannot shorten a chain, so renting a thousand servers buys a thousand waits, and each fake account costs hours, not cents. Hardware is as common as stones on a tundra; time is not. That gap is a basalt wall, not a fence: parallelism cannot climb it. Proofs bind to the key that began the chain, so outsourcing offers no haven. Honest agents wait once per epoch; a farm must wait a thousand times.
